title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds comprehensive request logging to yantraverse, providing valuable insights into application performance and errors, while also incorporating robust error handling to ensure reliable logging in production environments. It will log requests, responses, and errors, allowing developers to diagnose issues more efficiently. This feature will significantly enhance the framework's debugging capabilities
testCases: Test request logging with successful response
Test request logging with error response
Test logging with large request payload
acceptance: Request logging is successfully implemented, and error handling is properly configured to handle edge cases, with clear and concise logs generated for each request
reason: Implementing request logging with error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it enables developers to identify and resolve issues promptly, ultimately improving the overall user experience and application reliability
